Verify your organization

Tell us a bit about where your workspace lives and who’s on the team. This helps us route requests to the right region and tune defaults for your usage profile.

Workspace name
Available — clausal.dev/northwind-legal
Legal entity name (as it appears on invoices)
We’ll use this on receipts and DPAs. Editable later under Settings → Billing.
Data residency region
United States — us-east-1 (Virginia)
United States — us-west-2 (Oregon)
European Union — eu-west-1 (Frankfurt)
United Kingdom — uk-south-1 (London)
Asia Pacific — ap-southeast-2 (Sydney)
Canada — ca-central-1 (Montréal)
Documents and embeddings stay inside this region. Region cannot be changed after step 5.

Heads up — region is locked at first call

Once you make your first API call in step 5, the data residency region above is permanent for this workspace. Spin up a second workspace if you need a different region later.

What happens next
We’ll provision an isolated tenant in eu-west-1 and seed it with our default clause taxonomy (412 clause types).
You’ll pick a plan — every plan starts with a 14-day sandbox that doesn’t count against quota.
We’ll generate a live key and a test key, then walk you through POST /v1/reviews with a sample MSA.
Need a paralegal in the loop?

Pair every flagged clause with a 30-minute review from a licensed paralegal. Add the Human Review add-on at checkout or any time later.

Learn about Human Review

Can I change region later?
No — region is fixed after step 5. You can, however, run multiple workspaces under one billing account, each pinned to a different region.
